crossRefs.note: Yahweh was with him. Wherever he went, he prospered. He rebelled against the king of Assyria, and didn’t serve him.
The king of Israel answered, “It is according to your saying, my lord, O king. I am yours, and all that I have.”
The fear of man proves to be a snare, but whoever puts his trust in Yahweh is kept safe.
Or else, while the other is yet a great way off, he sends an envoy, and asks for conditions of peace.

people.name: Assyria
people.line: A powerful ancient empire, often in conflict with Israel.

translations.web: Hezekiah king of Judah sent to the king of Assyria to Lachish, saying, “I have offended you. Return from me. That which you put on me, I will bear.” The king of Assyria appointed to Hezekiah king of Judah three hundred talents of silver and thirty talents of gold.
translations.bsb: So Hezekiah king of Judah sent word to the king of Assyria at Lachish, saying, “I have done wrong; withdraw from me, and I will pay whatever you demand from me.” And the king of Assyria exacted from Hezekiah king of Judah three hundred talents of silver and thirty talents of gold.
translations.kjv: And Hezekiah king of Judah sent to the king of Assyria to Lachish, saying, I have offended; return from me: that which thou puttest on me will I bear. And the king of Assyria appointed unto Hezekiah king of Judah three hundred talents of silver and thirty talents of gold.
